<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=76849 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
This is fixed on current `main`; closing as an automated hermes-sweeper review.

- `0ee9723b52c7b5483e58084f687ff6a7f470eccd` changed macOS/Linux Desktop updates to bypass the staged installer hand-off that could deadlock against its own update lock and show “Hermes is still running.”
- `apps/desktop/electron/main.ts:2853` now routes non-Windows updates through the in-app POSIX path.
- `apps/desktop/electron/updater-process.ts:54` documents and enforces the Windows-only hand-off policy; `apps/desktop/electron/updater-process.test.ts:141` covers the non-Windows behavior.
- The POSIX updater also preserves Desktop-managed backend PIDs during `hermes update` (`apps/desktop/electron/main.ts:3318`), preventing the update path from killing the active Desktop backend.
